text:
tara: Final preflight for launch post + webinar landing. Need: H1/H2 keyword checks, JSON-LD (WebinarEvent + FAQ), internal anchors, and decide signup redirect behavior + UTM mapping. Publish window tonight.

mike: Keywords: primary 'inference benchmarks', secondary 'LLM inference cost'. Use longtail H2s like 'real-world inference benchmarks' and 'reduce per-token cost'. Keep meta description under 155 chars.

jules: I'll add a compact WebinarEvent JSON-LD in the head and a small FAQPage block for 3 Q/A pairs. That should help SERP snippets.

jules: Snippet (will paste exact JSON-LD into head): ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebinarEvent","name":"Redwood: Inference Benchmarks","startDate":"2026-07-15T16:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.com/webinar"}}```

anya: Redirect plan: marketing prefers /webinar-access -> /pricing/signup?src=webinar_post. Dev asks use 302 for initial 48h test (Cache-Control: no-cache) then flip to 301. Agree?

tara: Yes 302 for 48h then 301. Add a release task to verify Location keeps UTM params.

sales-ops-bot: UTM mapping proposed: utm_source=webinar_post -> queue:inbound-sdr; utm_campaign=launch_jul -> campaign:launch_jul. Fallback tag: webinar_manual_review. Will email ops.

mike: Internal linking anchors on post: '#benchmarks' (Benchmarks), '#method' (Methodology), '#cost' (Cost impact). Add contextual links from Docs: Deployments > Dedicated -> /webinar with phrase 'benchmarks on Dedicated'.

publish-bot: Staging preview: https://staging.redwood.com/webinar-launch (build-618). Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.com/previews/618.png

tara: Action items: jules add JSON-LD + FAQ to draft, anya implement temporary 302 and cache header on staging, sales-ops-bot send mapping, mike finalize H2s/meta. I'll run curl smoke tests tomorrow morning and flip redirect to 301 after 48h if stable. :white_check_mark:
